basic_details.job_title: CCRAS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 20 Ph.D Fellowships/ Junior Research Fellowships Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences (CCRAS) has released the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 notification under Advertisement No. 05/2026/Ph.D. A total of 20 fellowship vacancies are available in Ayurveda and Yoga & Naturopathy. Eligible candidates with a postgraduate qualification in Biomedical Sciences and a valid eligible NET certificate can apply online through the CCRAS Ph.D. Portal. The last date to submit the application is 08 December 2026. Candidates can check the notification PDF and apply online link below.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Up to Two Months (60 days) from the date of advertisement in the Employment News (08-12-2026)

how_to_apply: Interested candidates possessing the prescribed qualifications must apply online only.
Register on the CCRAS Ph.D. Portal (https://phd.ccras.org.in/).
Submit the application form, research proposal, and all required documents online for the respective streams of interest (Ayurveda & Yoga & Naturopathy).

Send hard copies of the registration/application link along with all required documents in hand before opening of registration/application link as on the date of publication of advertisement in the Employment News.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The total number of vacancies is 20, which are distributed across participating Research Councils as follows:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualification and eligibility criteria prescribed for the Ph.D. fellowships. Candidates from Non-Ayush (Non-Medical) background must have qualified the concerned National Eligibility Test, namely Joint CSIR-UGC test for JRF and LS(NET), DBT- JRF in Biotechnology, Bio technology Eligibility Test (BET), ICAR's AICE- SRF(PGS), and ICMR JRF and willing to undertake research on AYUSH related projects for pursuing Ph.D. programmes in the University/ Institution of their choice. Research project shall be in the fields of Biomedical Sciences with emphasis on Life Sciences such as Microbiology, Physiology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Human Biology, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Immunology, Pharmacology, Zoology, Environment Science, Botany, Veterinary Sciences, and Pharmacy etc.; Chemical Sciences such as Biochemistry, Chemistry including Analytical Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry and Organic Chemistry - Phyto Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry & Natural Product Chemistry etc.; Physical Sciences including Biophysics; Social Sciences such as Psychology for Mental diseases and Sociology for Demographic Survey etc.; and Biostatistics.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduation in Biomedical Sciences (with emphasis on Life Sciences / Chemical Sciences / Physical Sciences / Social Sciences/ Biostatistics and having a NET certificate with eligible validity period

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship will be provided for pursuing Ph.D. under a recognised University/ institution of choice by the candidates and during their fellowship, they will be termed as Junior Research Fellows (JRFs) for 2 years extendable as Senior Research Fellows (SRF) for 2-3 years, total for maximum 5 years. The monthly emoluments will be Rs. 37,000/- for JRF and Rs. 42,000/- for SRF + House Rent Allowance per month + annual contingency of Rs. 20,000/- to the University/ Institution. In addition, the fellow may submit a project proposal to obtain one time Research Contingency Grant-in-Aid up to Rs. 01.00 lakh within 3 months of joining the fellowship.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed and invited for interview by the respective Councils.

faq.question: Q1. What is the upper age limit to apply for CCRAS Junior Research Fellow (JRF)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on the date of issue of advertisement in the Employment News, with relaxation up to 5 years in the case of candidates belonging to Schedule Castes/Schedule Tribes/OBC, Physically Handicapped (lower cooperative disability only) and female applicants.

faq.question: Q2. Is there any application fee required for CCRAS JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q3. Where should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the CCRAS Ph.D. Portal at https://phd.ccras.org.in/ and also submit hard copies of registration and documents in hand.

faq.question: Q4. What are the streams available under CCRAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The streams available are Ayurveda under CCRAS with 16 fellowships and Yoga & Naturopathy under CCRYN with 04 fellowships.
